common:generalComment.#text: Lubricating oil is a liquid product derived from the refining and processing of petroleum, primarily used to reduce friction and wear. It contains various hydrocarbons along with additives that enhance oxidation resistance, cleanliness, and foam control, allowing it to perform well under harsh operating conditions. As an essential maintenance material, lubricating oil plays a vital role in automobiles, industrial equipment, and other machinery.
润滑油则是通过对石油精炼和加工得到的液态产品，主要用于减少摩擦和磨损。润滑油中包含多种碳氢化合物，以及抗氧化、清洁和抗泡沫的添加剂，这些特性使其能够在严苛的工作条件下保持良好的性能。作为重要的机械维护材料，润滑油在汽车、工业设备及其他机械中扮演着至关重要的角色。

common:generalComment.#text: Clinker is a primary product used in the production of cement, characterized by its nodular form resulting from the sintering of limestone and clay. It's processed through a high-temperature kiln, is compliant with industry quality standards, is utilized as a key component in the manufacturing of Portland cement, is produced via the calcination route, with limestone as the main raw material. It is typically provided in a form that is ready to be ground to make cement, to consumer or at plant.

common:generalComment.#text: Polyester resin is a type of high-molecular compound synthesized through polycondensation reactions of polyacids (such as phthalic anhydride and terephthalic acid) and polyols (such as ethylene glycol and propylene glycol). According to its chemical structure, it can be divided into two major categories: unsaturated polyester resin (UPR, containing unsaturated double bonds, and can be cross-linked and cured at room temperature) and saturated polyester resin (without unsaturated bonds, requiring high temperature or special curing agents). It is one of the most widely used thermosetting/thermoplastic resins. Its core feature is that unsaturated polyester resin has the advantages of fast curing at room temperature, simple molding process (suitable for hand lay-up, compression molding, pultrusion, spray molding and other processes), economic cost, and good compatibility with reinforcing materials such as glass fiber. After curing, it has certain mechanical strength, corrosion resistance and insulation. Saturated polyester resin is characterized by excellent weather resistance, resistance to chemical medium corrosion and gloss stability. This material is widely used in the field of composite materials (such as base materials for wind turbine blades, fiberglass reinforced plastic products, and lightweight automotive components), the coatings industry (coil coatings, automotive topcoats, anti-corrosion coatings), adhesives, artificial stone (artificial marble, quartz stone), and electronic packaging, among other scenarios. Among them, unsaturated polyester resin is favored for its high cost performance and flexible molding It is a commonly used base resin for reinforcing composite materials of wind turbine blades and photovoltaic module frames, meeting the weather resistance and mechanical performance requirements for long-term outdoor use of new energy facilities. It is a core polymer material that takes into account practicality, economy and processing adaptability.

聚酯树脂是一类以多元酸（如邻苯二甲酸酐、对苯二甲酸）与多元醇（如乙二醇、丙二醇）通过缩聚反应合成的高分子化合物，按化学结构可分为不饱和聚酯树脂（UPR，含不饱和双键，可常温交联固化）与饱和聚酯树脂（无不饱和键，需高温或特殊固化剂）两大类，是应用最广泛的热固性 / 热塑性树脂之一。其核心特性为不饱和聚酯树脂兼具常温固化快、成型工艺简单（适配手糊、模压、拉挤、喷射等工艺）、成本经济、与玻璃纤维等增强材料相容性好的优势，固化后具备一定的机械强度、耐腐蚀性与绝缘性；饱和聚酯树脂则以优异的耐候性、耐化学介质腐蚀及光泽稳定性为特点。该材料广泛应用于复合材料领域（如风电叶片基体材料、玻璃钢制品、汽车轻量化部件）、涂料工业（卷材涂料、汽车面漆、防腐涂料）、胶粘剂、人造石材（人造大理石、石英石）及电子封装等场景，其中不饱和聚酯树脂因性价比高、成型灵活，是风电叶片、光伏组件边框增强复合材料的常用基体树脂，适配新能源设施户外长期使用的耐候性与力学性能需求，是兼顾实用性、经济性与加工适配性的核心高分子材料。

common:generalComment.#text: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) is a product flow characterized by being a flammable mixture of hydrocarbon gases used as fuel in heating appliances, cooking equipment, and vehicles. It typically contains processing levels involving refining and condensation, adherence to safety and quality standards, and is commonly used as a heating source or automotive fuel. The production involves the separation and collection of gases during natural gas purification or oil refining, with educt names including propane and butane. It can be part of both production and consumption mixes and is available in cylinders or bulk for various sectors like domestic, commercial, and industrial 'to consumer', or 'at plant'.
液化石油气 (LPG) 是一种可燃的碳氢化合物气体混合物，用作加热器具、烹饪设备和车辆的燃料。它通常包括提炼和冷凝的处理水平，符合安全和质量标准，并且常作为加热源或者汽车燃料使用。其生产过程包括在天然气净化或油品精炼过程中分离和收集气体，原料名称包括丙烷和丁烷。它可以是生产和消费混合物的一部分，并且以气瓶或散装的形式为家庭、商业和工业等不同领域提供 '给消费者' 或 '在工厂'。

common:generalComment.#text: Nonwoven fabric is a fabric-like material made from staple fibre and long fibres bonded together by chemical, mechanical, or heat processes. It has various properties such as strength, durability, absorbency, breathability, and cost-effectiveness. It is used in various industries including medical, geotextile, automotive, filtration, packaging, apparel, and home furnishings. It can be made from polymers, such as polypropylene or viscose rayon, and is often used in disposable products, such as napkins and wipes, but also in more durable products like roofing materials and geotextiles.
无纺布是一种由短纤维和长纤维通过化学、机械或热处理过程粘合在一起的类似织物的材料。它具有各种性能，如强度、耐用性、吸水性、透气性和成本效益。它在各种行业中都有应用，包括医疗、土工布、汽车、过滤、包装、服装和家居装饰。它可以由聚合物（如聚丙烯或粘胶纤维）制成，常用于一次性产品（如餐巾和湿巾），但也用于更耐用的产品，如屋顶材料和土工布。

common:generalComment.#text: Fired magnesite brick, often referred to simply as magnesia brick, is a widely used alkaline brick. It is manufactured with magnesite as the raw material after smashing, burdening, mulling and molding through firing in the high temperature of 1550~1600℃. High purity products' firing temperature is over 1750℃. The mass fraction of MgO in magnesia is between 89% and 98%. The limit particle size is generally 3 to 5mm.
经过烧制的镁质砖，通常简称为镁砖，是一种广泛使用的碱性砖。它是以镁石为原料，经过粉碎、装料、混磨和成型，通过在1550~1600℃的高温下烧制而成。高纯度产品的烧制温度超过1750℃。镁砖中MgO的质量分数在89%和98%之间。限制粒径通常为3至5毫米。

It is a convenient alternative to plaster used for interior walls and ceilings. The board is made of gypsum plaster sandwiched between heavy paper or fiberglass surface sheets. It becomes strong and rigid once dried and is ready for use as a building material.

common:generalComment.#text: - plywood is a panel consisting of an assembly of veneer sheets of tropical wood bonded together with the direction of the grain in alternate plies generally at right angles. The veneer sheets are usually placed symmetrically on both sides of a central ply or core that may itself be made from a veneer sheet or another material. It includes veneer plywood, core plywood or blockboard, cellular board and composite plywood. It excludes laminated construction materials (e.g. glulam), where the grain of the veneer sheets generally runs in the same direction.

胶合板是一种由多层热带木单板组装而成的板材，各层单板纤维方向在相邻层之间通常呈直角交错排列。单板通常以中心层或芯层为对称中心，分别铺设在其两侧，该中心层或芯层本身可以由单板或其他材料制成。胶合板包括单板胶合板、芯板胶合板或木芯板（blockboard）、空心板（cellular board）和复合胶合板（composite plywood）。不包括层压结构材料（如胶合木 glulam），此类材料中各层单板的纤维方向通常基本一致。
